name: topo
description: Zoomable maps of software systems, read from their code: point it at one or more repositories and get one HTML page that zooms from the whole system to single functions, with every connection and every claim checked against the code it cites.

interface.shortDescription: Map your code into one zoomable page
interface.longDescription: Map repositories into one zoomable page checked against their code (map), keep it current (refresh), and share an anonymized copy of a private map (share).
